turn.content: The contract contains no price for either line item, and the only addendum (clause 11.1) covers only "Kursi Kantor Ergonomis" and sets a price from 19 September 2026 — it does not touch Papan Tulis Putih or Map Arsip Ordner. So neither the "contract sets the price" nor the "effective later" exception applies to these lines; the invoice simply exceeds the PO price.
